name: Banjarbaru

requestOutcomes.httpStatus: 200 via indexed first-party page; direct curl connection failed during this attempt
requestOutcomes.outcome: Official BAPPERIDA page describes the Signature land-parcel WebGIS and links the public ArcGIS app.
Official city geoportal loaded and identifies the city's geospatial network node; categories include KADASTER.
Official city one-map page exposed public service URL/type controls and documented GeoServer, ESRI, Palapa and CSW service forms; no parcel service URL was enumerated in the page response.
Current public app configuration identified web map item 9724b6b456994fb596e6f5f4353dba54.
Web map operational layer identified the public Banjarbaru_Utara Persil Lahan FeatureServer layer.
Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, EPSG-compatible spatial reference, objectIdField OBJECTID, source field list, and local layer extent.

Exact WUP point spatial-intersects query returned an empty GeoJSON FeatureCollection; bounded first-page query with where=1=1, outFields=OBJECTID, resultRecordCount=3 and outSR=4326 returned three full polygons. Only safe IDs and geometry were retained.
Anonymous REST enumeration was unauthorized; this was recorded as an access limitation and not treated as service absence.
Returned the Geoportal HTML shell rather than an ArcGIS REST directory; no service list was qualified from this route.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: GeoJSON response declared EPSG:4326; coordinates are [longitude, latitude].

nativeFieldMapping.OBJECTID: ArcGIS native object identifier; only retained identity field
nativeFieldMapping.KODEPERSIL: source parcel-code field, not requested or retained
nativeFieldMapping.KELURAHAN: source neighborhood field, not requested or retained
nativeFieldMapping.PEMILIK: unsafe owner field present in schema, not requested
nativeFieldMapping.APEMILIK: unsafe owner-address field present in schema, not requested

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Not applicable; native OBJECTID qualified by the FeatureServer service URL was used.

qualification.reason: A real anonymous public parcel response is verified for Banjarbaru Utara, but exact-point coverage is empty, citywide coverage is unresolved, and adapter admission requires independent serial review.

scopeLimits: One bounded local-layer response is not citywide coverage evidence.
The exact-point miss, GeoServer 401, and HTML shell from the guessed ArcGIS REST route are not treated as absence.
The service layer's old edit timestamp and limited district scope make recency/completeness uncertain.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS verification disablement were used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The official city geoportal and BAPPERIDA-linked public app expose an anonymous Banjarbaru Utara parcel layer with polygon geometry and native OBJECTID. Other districts, cadastral legal authority, current completeness, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
